text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: (Ahh, running is so fun!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Fine Motion!
You were wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
She looked like she was having so much
fun out
there—I couldn't take my eyes
off her!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
This is seriously gonna be Fine Motion's
year!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, I just realized... Do you think it's
okay to
refer to her like that?!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're right! Um... maybe "lady"
works? Lady
Fine Motion?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, please refer to me just as you
would
anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And thank you so much for your
cheers! ♪ Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Formerly Trembling Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Fine!

text_block_list.name: Formerly Trembling Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry about before. I'd just got so
afraid of
running...

text_block_list.name: Formerly Trembling Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
But I was drawn in by how you ran, and I
started
to enjoy it myself. I'm going to
do my best to feel
that way again!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Great! I'll be rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm back. Today was so much fun! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion greets me happily, but for
some
reason, I sense something off
about her smile.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Pardon? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list: 何もないならいいんだけど……
choice_data_list_en: If it's nothing, then that's fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking about something. But
it really
isn't important.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking about how everyone is
running
with their own unique
circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's something I should have realized
long ago!
They aren't out there running
just for the sake of
it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to the Classics in
particular... there
are many who dream
solely of running in them.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But it's different for me. I've always had
my duties
apart from racing...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's not it. At least, I'd like to think
it's a little
different.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Actually, that would be rather
disrespectful. I'm
here because I'm
qualified to be here, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So it's not about feeling inferior. It's
more like...
It's difficult to put into
words.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Believe me, I know. Let's just move on...
choice_data_list: 君にも君の事情がある
貴方にも貴方の事情がある
choice_data_list_en: You have your own circumstances, too.
You have your own circumstances, too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list: 走ることが夢だっていいんだ
走ることが夢だっていいんだよ
choice_data_list_en: It's fine if running itself is your dream.
It's completely fine if running itself is your dream.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're right. Running has surely
always been
my dream.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Sigh... But still, I couldn't believe it when I realized how selfish I've been!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was rather serious about wanting
everyone to do
their best for my sake. I
feel like I've discovered a
new side of
myself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The desire to compete with everything
you
have—that may be something every
Umamusume
possesses from birth.
choice_data_list: きっと本能じゃないかな

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Instinct, you say...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I can't say I'd be happy if that were the
case.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing! I'm going to go get
changed!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh. It's still so bright outside.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Really?!
choice_data_list_en: Summer will be here before we know it.
Summer will be here before we know it, huh.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh! That means summer camp, right?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy holds a camp each year
when
the weather turns to the warmer.
It's a great
opportunity to have the
runners really hone in on
core skills.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That means going out and having a
sleepover
with everyone! I can hardly
wait.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And training, of course!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And then once camp is over, the final
stop on the
Triple Tiara tour—the Shuka
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion is focused on her next race.
It's
almost as if the spectacle of the
Shuka Sho is
already a twinkle in her
eyes.
